name: Panelicious
description:
Place delicious panels anywhere on your screen with Panelicious. Your most important files, folders, and apps always at your fingertips.
• Keep files, folders, and apps in your panels—you can even keep them all in the same panel.
• Customize your panels by changing the material, theme, and position.
• When you don't need your panels, quickly hide them from the menu bar.
